prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Desktop Companion Controls", "Try calling and dragging your pet right here so you know exactly how to interact on your desktop."]
1: ["Upload High-Quality Pet Photos", "Use clear lighting and centered framing for the crispest 3D pet generation.", "Select Pet Photo", "Live Quality Preview"]
2: ["Choose Your Pet's Archetype", "Select a personality style to match how your pet will roam and interact on your screen.", "Playful Explorer vs Chill Companion"]
3: ["Secure Sign-In & Pet Protection", "Sign in to ensure your pet profile and customizations are backed up safely."]
4: ["Designing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "Customize your pet's starting toys while we finish downloading assets.", "Pick Starter Toy", "Asset Download Progress"]
5: ["Center your pet's head within the circle and use bright room lighting for best 3D accuracy."]
6: ["Includes Free Early Adopter Crown Accessory"]
7: ["Save Your Adoption Progress", "Link your account now to sync your desktop pet across all your devices seamlessly."]
8: ["Allow desktop display permission when prompted so your companion can spawn over windows."]
9: ["Your Pet is Live! Find it in System Tray", "If your pet wanders off or gets hidden, click the tray icon near your desktop clock anytime to recall it."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or promotional gifts
